nodes.label: Tier-1 Continuation Plan
nodes.rationale: Four independent subsystems (a11y, asset/perf, CI infra, architecture brainstorming) kept as one plan because each is too small to justify its own; phase order is recommended but not load-bearing except Phase 3 which must follow Phase 2.

nodes.label: Panel-open focus management (a11y)
nodes.rationale: docs/systems/accessibility.md:91 promised focus moves to the panel heading when the country panel opens, but SingleCountryPanel had a panelRootRef with no .focus() call — a real WCAG 2.4.3 bug leaving screen-reader users with no announcement. Fix: tabIndex={-1} + headingRef focused inside a requestAnimationFrame so the DOM commits before focus moves.

nodes.label: countries-10m to countries-50m chunk swap
nodes.rationale: The async countries chunk had drifted to 954 KB gzip; world-atlas countries-50m.json is ~4.8x smaller than 10m. The visual-fidelity tradeoff (missing small island states rendered as synthetic 1deg squares) was accepted per 2026-05-14 user decision because the polygons are still clickable, which is what gameplay needs. Abort rule: if more than 5 canonical IDs are missing, the patching effort is not worth it and 10m stays.

nodes.label: missingCountriesPatch synthetic geometry
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes a tiny square polygon around each missing entity's centroid. Geographic accuracy is irrelevant — the polygon only needs to be clickable so queryRenderedFeatures returns the feature ID, keeping every canonical-195 country present without ballooning the bundle back to 10m.

nodes.label: Bundle-size budget CI gate
nodes.rationale: The 2026-05-11 audit found the real bundle was 2x the documented budget (710 KB documented vs 1,461 KB measured). Budgets set to measured+10%: the headroom prevents trivial-cause flake (a new icon adding 200 bytes) while still catching real regressions. Raising a budget requires measurement evidence in the commit message. Must be sequenced after the 50m swap because the numbers derive from post-swap sizes.

nodes.label: playwright-matrix.md refresh
nodes.rationale: The matrix was two doc-revisions stale: it still showed the chromium/chromium-gpu split consolidated on 2026-05-02 when Software ANGLE was dropped, omitted four newer specs, and documented neither the 13-spec CI testIgnore list nor the 5 test.fixme quarantines (#31, #32, #47).

nodes.label: GameController extraction brainstorm (Phase 4 deliverable)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately produces a plan, not code: GameController.tsx is 833 lines with 9 ref-mirrors and comments referencing bug #32 (closure-staleness, two-render race), flagged by the 2026-05-11 audit as the largest single architectural risk and the most likely site of the next regression.
